subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment.**

I thought I finished my work but I realised that all of my work is faulty. I have to __start it over again__.

options.text: get a pat on the back
go back to the drawing board

solution:
The correct answer is **"go back to the drawing board."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• This idiom means to start something over again because it was not successful or satisfactory.
 
• **"Go back to the drawing board"** is often used in situations where a plan or idea did not work out as exp
